proposition_id.format: stable hash of core + provenance anchor

motivating_observation.purpose: Human-auditable statement of what was empirically seen (not template text)

surprise_or_uncertainty.purpose: Why evidence is surprising, unresolved, asymmetric, conflicting, or unexplained

scientific_question.purpose: Question arising from evidence — must not be isomorphic to catalog template question_text

canonical_proposition_core.purpose: Executable semantic identity for dedup and blind eval

population_context.purpose: Who is being studied — derived from evidence context

observation_horizon.purpose: Horizon when scientifically relevant to the proposition

falsifiable_expectation.purpose: What result pattern would support vs weaken the proposition

null_competing_explanation.purpose: Plausible alternative explanation the proposition discriminates against

evidence_required.purpose: What new empirical evidence would resolve the uncertainty

confidence.purpose: Grounding strength — not market edge confidence

semantic_parent_id.purpose: Prior proposition this derives from (evidence-responsive fork)

generation_lineage.purpose: Audit chain from root observation to this record

executability_status.purpose: Whether existing validation can bind an ExperimentSpec

explicitly_excluded_fields.planner_score: Ranking belongs downstream — not part of proposition birth
explicitly_excluded_fields.template_id_used: Must not be populated at synthesis time; only post-hoc audit may compare
